name: campusconnect
description: CampusConnect - Student campus-issue reporting and resolution platform

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix app install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.serve:prod: npm --prefix ui run build && npm --prefix ui start
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix app test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.typecheck:all: npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
